subject: Post-call: deployment routing + artifact checklist for HIPAA/BAA
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@cedarpointhealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: 
Date: Tue, 03 Nov 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: deployment routing + artifact checklist for HIPAA/BAA

Hi Elena — great conversation earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can align the procurement + security teams at CedarPoint.

Call summary (30 mins):
- CedarPoint is evaluating using LLM-powered triage for intake forms (PHI in payloads).
- Primary preference: Private VPC (customer-managed networking) if we can meet BAA and provide SOC2 artifacts and network segmentation docs.
- Secondary option: Dedicated capacity (reserved GPUs) with strict egress controls if VPC is cost-prohibitive. Hosted API considered last-resort with tokenization and strict retention rules.

What we need from Redwood (asks from CedarPoint security/procurement):
1) List of artifacts for security review (SOC2, BAA, encryption-at-rest details, KMS/HSM integration notes).
2) Estimated timeline to produce any missing artifacts (SOC2 evidence extracts, network diagrams for Private VPC).
3) Clear delta between Dedicated vs Private VPC for audit scope and ongoing responsibilities.

Action items I’m proposing (owner in parens):
- Share SOC2 Type 2 extract (Okta/identity, change management scope) and network segmentation doc (Marcus) — attachment: SOC2_Type2_Redwood_Okta_2026.pdf
- Draft BAA for CedarPoint review (Marissa) — attachment: BAA_Draft_CedarPoint_v3.docx
- Push short comparison sheet (Private VPC vs Dedicated vs Hosted) with operational responsibilities and expected SLA/latency differences (Kimberly) — attachment: deployment-options-comparison.xlsx

Timelines: if CedarPoint can review the SOC2 extract this week, Marissa and I can get a BAA draft over by Friday. Kimberly will have the options matrix by Thursday EOD.

Next meeting? Elena suggested a follow-up with CedarPoint security on Friday 11/6 — Marcus, can you and Kimberly make that?

Thanks — I’ll queue the artifacts to the Drive link and add the HubSpot record.

—
Marcus Lin
Enterprise Lead, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0172
From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@cedarpointhealth.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: CedarPoint Health Security <security@cedarpointhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 03 Nov 2026 16:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: deployment routing + artifact checklist for HIPAA/BAA

Thanks Marcus — that recap is perfect. Quick clarifications from our side:
- CedarPoint’s security team will only sign off on production PHI if we have either a customer-managed VPC with documented segmentation and single-tenant guarantees, or a Dedicated pool with contractual guarantees and a BAA that explicitly covers token/PHI handling.
- Our procurement prefers the Private VPC for long-term control, but the decision depends on whether you can provide the SOC2 evidence scoped to identity and change management (we need the control narratives and the evidence file names).
- Also need: list of third-party subprocessors, retention policy for logs and model inputs, and whether Redwood supports HSM-backed KMS (we run HSM keys on our side ideally).

Can we get the SOC2 extract and subprocessor list into the Drive today? If so, security will triage and we can target the Friday 11/6 call. Also — if there are any known gaps for Private VPC (e.g., automation gaps that would require lead time), flag them now so procurement understands delivery risk.

Elena
Elena Ruiz
Head of Information Security, CedarPoint Health
elena.ruiz@cedarpointhealth.com
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@cedarpointhealth.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: 
Date: Wed, 04 Nov 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: deployment routing + artifact checklist for HIPAA/BAA

Thanks Elena — quick update and what we’re attaching now.

Attachments included in Drive (shared):
- SOC2_Type2_Redwood_Okta_2026.pdf — contains test procedures and evidence file names for identity and change management controls.
- deployment-options-comparison.xlsx — short table: Private VPC vs Dedicated vs Hosted (responsibilities, expected latency delta, audit owner, typical lead time).

Answers to specific asks:
- Third-party subprocessors: listed in the SOC2 supplement and summarized in the Drive doc (we use certain telemetry and metrics providers; none see unredacted PHI).
- KMS/HSM: Redwood supports customer-managed KMS in Private VPC deployments and can integrate with customer HSM-backed key stores; we’ll include the integration checklist.
- Retention: default retention for request payloads in Hosted is 30 days (configurable); Dedicated/Private deployments can be configured to 0 days with sticky caching disabled — we’ll document this in the matrix.

Gaps / lead time:
- Private VPC onboarding requires 3–4 weeks for network validation and PKI/KMS exchange if CedarPoint requires HSM rotation procedures.
- Dedicated pool take-provisioning is ~2–3 weeks with priority commit; SLA for single-tenant guarantees is contractual.

Planned deliverables and owners:
- Marissa: BAA_Draft_CedarPoint_v3.docx (shared for legal comments) — target Fri 11/06
- Marcus: SOC2 extract and drive link (done) — see Drive link below
- Kimberly: options matrix and onboarding lead-time table (done)

Drive link (read-only): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cBAA-evidence
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/company/cedarpoint-health

—
Kimberly Park
Principal Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com

To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Thu, 05 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: deployment routing + artifact checklist for HIPAA/BAA

Appreciate the fast turnaround — I reviewed the SOC2 extract and the options matrix with our security lead. A couple quick notes:
- SOC2 extract looks sufficient for initial triage; security will follow up if they need the original evidence bundle (they may ask for a redacted log sample).
- Private VPC onboarding lead-time (3–4 weeks) is acceptable — procurement will table Dedicated if the BAA & VPC contract language are clear.
- We accepted the meeting for Fri 11/06 at 09:00 PT to review the BAA draft and onboarding checklist.

Please include the procurement contact (cc’d here: procurement@cedarpointhealth.com) on the Friday invite and share a brief agenda (15 minutes: BAA review, 15 minutes: onboarding timeline/questions).

I’ll put a note in HubSpot and attach our standard vendor security questionnaire for completeness.

Thanks — Elena
